windows.synchronization: not synchronized according to Windows Time status

sourceObservation: Boot IDs obtained by read-only cat in Ubuntu and a --rm MariaDB-image container; clock offsets are independently measured in before and common-clock-aligned-*.
causalScope: The proven cause of these test failures is the mismatch between the Node-Windows and SQL-WSL clock domains. The historical event that initiated clock drift is not established.
procedure: Use the already NTP-synchronized Linux clock for both Node and MariaDB in isolated worktrees; no system clock override or record timestamp changes.
ntpStatusCaveat: systemd reports NTPSynchronized=yes, but the supplementary timesync-status reports +8.074607s; only relative Node-Linux/MariaDB alignment is certified, not zero absolute NTP error.
